summary: New S1 entries from the 22-27 independent second opinion (codex, gpt-6.1-sol, run in a locked-down container with no file or shell tools), presented together once the merge was complete. Three entries, all in the BUY area. AUD-BUY-027: new-pair events are not limited to pairs with the wrapped-native token, so the checks can read one pair and the buy use another. AUD-BUY-028: the liquidity-lock gate passes on any active lock, however small a share of the LP tokens it covers. AUD-BUY-030 (candidate, not reproduced): the deliberate public buy is not pinned to the private attempt nonce, so a late private landing can make it a second buy.
